answers.value: All engineers joining the Software Engineering & Delivery org (target ~6-10 hires/quarter); scope = access provisioning, environment setup, and completion of the mandatory onboarding runbook checklist for each named hire.
First 30 days from the hire's start date; onboarding runbook must be signed off no later than day 30, with day-1/day-7/day-30 milestone gates tracked in the hire's ServiceNow onboarding case.

Each ServiceNow onboarding case must carry: hire name, start date, assigned Tech Lead/buddy, team, and the linked Confluence runbook version; provisioning tasks (repo access, CI/CD, IAM group) all in state Closed-Complete before the case can close.

Count of onboarding checklist items marked Complete equals total items in the runbook version (0 open items); repo/tooling access grants reconcile 1:1 to the role-based access template for the hire's title.
Retain the completed onboarding checklist as a PDF/record attached to the ServiceNow case with close timestamp and runbook version tag; retention 3 years per HR/audit policy.

Any incomplete item at day 30 logged as an exception on the ServiceNow case with owner = assigned Tech Lead and a remediation due date; escalate to Engineering Manager if open beyond 10 business days.
Compare the hire's granted access set post-provisioning against the role-based access baseline for their title; comparison must show 0 excess grants and 0 missing required grants before sign-off.
Every provisioning action links to the ServiceNow onboarding case number (format INC/RITM); no manual access grant permitted without a linked ticket.
Onboarding completion decision recorded in the ServiceNow case activity log by the Tech Lead, stating checklist complete and access verified against baseline.
Notify the hiring Engineering Manager, HR business partner, and team distribution list on case closure; recipients captured in the ServiceNow case watch-list.
Sample the last quarter's onboarding cases (or 100% if fewer than 20); verify each has a completed runbook and access reconciliation record.
Pass = every sampled case has checklist 100% complete, access reconciled to baseline, and sign-off captured; fail if any case is missing sign-off or shows unreconciled access.
Failed cases raised as ServiceNow exception tasks, owner = Engineering Manager, 10-business-day remediation SLA; access anomalies routed to IAM for immediate review.
Onboarding runbook version approved by the Platform Engineering Lead; current version tag recorded on the Confluence page and referenced in each case.
Role-based access baselines sourced from the IAM access template repository (Okta/SailPoint) keyed by job title; runbook content sourced from the team Confluence knowledge base.

Access grants beyond standard developer role require approval per the delegation matrix: Engineering Manager for elevated app roles, CISO delegate for production/PII access; approval recorded in ServiceNow before grant.

answers.value: Production streaming pipelines on the real-time platform (Kafka topics feeding the lakehouse) whose consumer lag or throughput breached SLA in the last 30 days; scope = partition counts, consumer parallelism, and back-pressure/rate-limit settings for those topics.
Tuning window covers the trailing 30 days of production telemetry; changes validated over a 7-day post-change observation period before closing the change.

Telemetry inputs must include per-topic consumer lag, records/sec throughput, end-to-end p99 latency, and error rate for the tuning window; each metric non-null and sourced from the observability platform dashboard for the target service.

Post-tune, sustained consumer lag returns to <= agreed SLA (e.g. p99 lag < 5s / < 10k messages) and throughput handles peak load with < 70% partition utilization; before/after metric deltas recorded in the change ticket.
Attach before/after dashboard snapshots and the applied config diff to the ServiceNow change ticket with timestamp and pipeline config version/commit SHA.
Any topic still breaching SLA after tuning logged as an exception on the change ticket with owner = Data Engineer and a follow-up capacity/design review scheduled within 5 business days.
The specific tuned topics/consumer groups (named), replayed under representative peak load in staging plus the 7-day production observation window.

Pass = p99 end-to-end latency and consumer lag within SLA under peak load with 0 dropped/duplicated records (idempotent replay verified); fail if lag grows unbounded or back-pressure causes upstream producer errors.
On fail, revert to the previous config version (stored in the CI/CD repo) via instant rollback and reopen the tuning task; escalate persistent SLA breach to Platform Engineering Lead.
Acceptance: sustained SLA compliance over the 7-day window (0 SLA-breach alerts), throughput headroom >= 30%, and no increase in downstream error rate vs. baseline.
Config diff and commit in the source/CI-CD repo; before/after telemetry and load-test results attached to the ServiceNow change ticket and linked from the service runbook.

testing.step: Compare post-tune metrics against the recorded baseline
testing.value: Post-tune p99 latency and lag improved vs. baseline and within SLA; delta table attached to ticket

checklist.step: Run a load test at representative peak volume in staging before promoting config to production
checklist.value: Load test at >= projected peak records/sec executed; results show SLA held with headroom

testing.step: Verify load-test evidence exists and passed for the applied settings
testing.value: Load-test report attached showing 0 SLA breaches and >=30% throughput headroom at peak

testing.value: Alert rules tested; no missed breaches and no alert-fatigue duplicates during the window

checklist.step: Confirm the pipeline remains idempotent under the new parallelism/back-pressure settings
checklist.value: Consumer processing keyed for at-least-once + dedup; replay of a partition produces no duplicate downstream records

testing.step: Replay a bounded offset range and check for duplicates
testing.value: Record counts before/after replay reconcile exactly; 0 duplicate keys in the sink
